name: VaultBridge
subtitle: Password vault for iPhone and Windows
description: Unsigned development builds. Manual Apple and Google password imports; live Firefox Sync and cross-device vault sync are not ready. Do not store real passwords until security validation is complete.

apps.name: VaultBridge
apps.subtitle: Multiple password sources in one local vault
apps.localizedDescription: Development preview. Import Apple Passwords, Google/Chrome or Firefox CSV, or add credentials manually. Passwords are locally protected. Live Firefox Sync, Windows browser autofill and end-to-end device sync are still pending.
